name: Desert milkweed
desc: Desert milkweed (Asclepias erosa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 23 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias erosa is a species of milkweed known commonly as desert milkweed. It is native to southern California, Arizona, and northern Baja California, where it is most abundant in the desert regions.
